$comment: Copy this file to <your-subdomain>.json and edit. Delete all $comment lines before opening your PR.

records.$comment: Pick ONE style: CNAME (most common) or A/AAAA. Supported: A, AAAA, CAA, CNAME, MX, TXT.

stacey.$comment: Set assistant:true to get the drop-in AI chat widget. Your site_id is generated automatically after merge — you NEVER put keys or IDs in this file. Configure your AI key at https://stacey.io/dashboard after your PR is merged.
stacey.$comment2: OPTIONAL: give your assistant a persona. Max 500 characters. This file is PUBLIC — no secrets here. It's layered UNDER stacey's base safety rules and can be edited later in your dashboard.
stacey.prompt: You are the friendly assistant for my project. Keep answers short, link to the docs page when relevant, and use a casual tone.
